title: A logistic equation with non-local operators of order near zero
summary: In this paper we study an equation driven by a non-local operator of order "near zero" with mixed Dirichlet-Neumann boundary conditions, modelling a biological system consisting of a population self-competing for resources in a closed environment and subject to an extremely heavy-tailed dispersal process. We establish several results concerning the existence of states in which the population can survive requiring different assumptions on the non-linear reaction term and on the various configurations of the sets where the Dirichlet or Neumann conditions hold.
